# Aero — Self-Hosted PaaS

> Aero transforms any physical PC, server, or cloud VM into a high-performance, private, self-hosted Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) with zero vendor lock-in and zero recurring cloud bills.

## Core Capabilities

- **One-Click Deployments**: Deploy Git repositories, Docker images, and Docker Compose files directly to your machines.
- **Docker-Native Mesh**: Built on Docker Engine with Traefik ingress proxy and Let's Encrypt automated SSL certificate provisioning.
- **Real-Time Observability**: Live stdout/stderr log streaming over WebSockets, CPU/RAM/Disk metrics, and health check monitoring.
- **Zero-Cloud-Bills**: Runs entirely on hardware you already own (bare metal, old PCs, homelab servers, or VPS nodes).
- **Encrypted Secrets Vault**: AES-256-GCM runtime environment variable injection with zero data leakage.
- **Public URL Tunnels**: Instant subdomains (`*.aerodeploy.app`) or custom domain mapping with automatic DNS verification.
- **Desktop & CLI Interfaces**: Native cross-platform desktop shell (Windows, macOS, Linux via Tauri) and terminal CLI (`aero`).

## Installation & Quickstart

```bash
# Install the Aero CLI globally
npm install -g aerodeploy

# Authenticate with your cluster
aero login

# Deploy any project or container
aero deploy

# Stream real-time logs
aero logs --follow

# Check node health & services
aero status
```
